input: Parallel AWS agent: aws-spend-guards + owner turnover runbook
errors: First pass built a parallel platform/aws/spend-guards stack before seeing that draft PR 18749 had platform/aws/stacks/spend. Another session flagged it; PR 18755 was held, then rebuilt as a follow-up on main after 18749 merged. About half the session's build time went into the first pass; its tests and design carried over.

registry.opentofu.org is refused by the session proxy. Providers came from releases.hashicorp.com (SHA256SUMS verified), whose zips do not match the OpenTofu registry checksums in the committed lock file; validation ran in a scratch copy without the lock, and the lock file is unchanged.
Installing Trivy was refused by the auto-mode classifier; Checkov ran, Trivy config did not.

doc_friction.issue: Lists AWS 'native limits, Paid-plan accounts only' as a hard cap. Searching found a per-project spend limit for accounts in the 'new AWS experience', limited rollout since September 2026, console-only with no API. It is not an account cap. Corrected in stacks/spend/README.md and the runbook; the report is left to its owner.

doc_friction.file: the six-agent AWS brief (session system message)
doc_friction.issue: Named platform/aws/<stack>/ and platform/aws/OWNER_RUNBOOK.md while PR 18749 was already building platform/aws/stacks/<stack>/ and docs/runbooks/aws-cutover.md. Searching open PR titles for the stack name found nothing (18749's title says aws-consolidation); grepping open PR file lists for platform/aws would have.

deviations.file: CLAUDE.md, 'Every session lands its own work'
deviations.why: Held PR 18755 unmerged for about 45 minutes instead of merging, because merging would have landed a second spend stack beside PR 18749's.
deviations.did: held, then rebuilt on main as a follow-up

deviations.why: The brief asked for the owner's steps in this file; 18749's docs/runbooks/aws-cutover.md already held most of them and the coordinator asked to extend it. The file is a pointer so the steps are written once.
deviations.did: pointer file, steps 8-9 and step 1/3 additions in aws-cutover.md

deviations.why: The draw picked quality/0; this was assigned platform work.

goal: Reach the AWS turnover point: spend guards apply-ready, the owner's steps written once.
notes:
Verification (run here, 2026-11-25, on main e98ec5cb + this diff):
- python3 -m pytest platform/aws/stacks/spend/kill_switch -q: 17 passed (9 existing + 8 new: ASG, event sources, Aurora, spot/SageMaker reporting, resume, exempt, kill_on_budget, two regions with IAM once, never deletes).
- python3 -m pytest platform/aws -q: 35 passed.
- OpenTofu 1.10.7 + aws 6.72.0/archive 2.8.1 from releases.hashicorp.com (checksums verified), in a scratch copy without the lock file (registry blocked here): stacks/spend fmt -check, validate, tofu test 6/6 (spend_shape, per_account_kill_switch_and_alerts, freeze_scp_leaves_data_logs_and_dns_alone, anomaly_detection, unknown_kill_switch_account_is_refused, alert_emails_are_sensitive_but_subscribed). Mutation: kill_switch_accounts=[apps,sandbox,payments] fails per_account_kill_switch_and_alerts as intended.
- stacks/baseline (consumes modules/account-baseline): validate + tofu test 1/1.
- Checkov -d stacks/spend -d modules/account-baseline: 96 passed, 0 failed, 7 skipped (all pre-existing from PR 18749).
- decision_queue.py --check OK (5 decisions); test_decision_queue.py 83 passed; workctl.py validate ok.
- stacks/spend/.terraform.lock.hcl unchanged (no new providers); priv-aws-plan.yml regenerates and compares it.
Nothing applied; no AWS account exists.
